name: left-hand-hook
why: Handedness, pinned where volume cannot see it: half a left-handed turn from +X spends itself at y <= 0 (y = -11 to +0.08, the end discs leaning), and a marker ball at y = +20 turns that position into a size, 32 mm deep in Y where the right-handed helix measures 21.08 with the identical volume. Closed form pi * 0.5 * sqrt((20 pi)^2 + 25) + 4/3 pi = 103.197 mm3; the exact B-rep reads 99.0080 + 4.1888 through BRepGProp. Two bodies on purpose.
